subject.title: [Feature]: Improve Workspace Skill Loading: Add Frontmatter Parsing Error Visibility and Validation for SKILL.md

question: Should malformed SKILL.md diagnostics be accepted as a new lint-only CLI surface first, or must normal skills list/check/status/Web output also expose skipped candidates before this issue is considered resolved?
rationale: Current main still lacks the requested visibility, and the open PR implements a narrower lint command while the issue asks for always-visible CLI and Web diagnostics.

options.title: Require normal status/list/Web diagnostics
options.body: Treat lint as useful but incomplete until the existing status pipeline can report skipped malformed candidates with safe path/error text.

options.title: Accept lint-first scope
options.body: Let the open PR close this issue if maintainers are comfortable making a dedicated lint command the supported validation path and tracking broader UI/status visibility separately.

options.title: Pause for redaction policy
options.body: Hold the implementation until maintainers define exactly how local paths and YAML parser messages should be exposed across CLI and Web surfaces.

recommendation.title: Require normal status/list/Web diagnostics
recommendation.body: Treat lint as useful but incomplete until the existing status pipeline can report skipped malformed candidates with safe path/error text.

likelyOwner.reason: He has recent parser, CLI, and docs history and is the clearest owner for the product-surface decision among the related history signals.
